title: Applying Word Embeddings to Measure Valence in Information Operations Targeting Journalists in Brazil
reasoning: The paper develops and uses a "purity" score as a key metric to analyze the discourse surrounding journalists. This score is explicitly based on the Moral Foundations Dictionary and uses words related to moral and religious concepts such as piety, sacredness, sin, decency, and impurity. This makes the evaluation of moral framing a core component of the paper's methodology.
